item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 01/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be relatively mild and humid with a few mist patches in the morning and at night over the coast of Guangdong for the rest of this week. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China during the weekend and bring cooler weather to the region early next week.

Date/Month: 01/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: Light winds force 2.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. Warm with sunny periods during the day. One or two light rain and mist patches at night.
Temp range: 18 - 25 C
R.H. range: 60 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 02/03 (Wednesday)

Weather: Misty in the morning. Warm with sunny periods during the day.

R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
